name: What preparations should I make before your team arrives for tile installation?

mainEntity.name: What preparations should I make before your team arrives for tile installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before our team arrives for tile installation, please ensure the bathroom area is clear of personal belongings, furniture, and any items that could obstruct the workspace. If possible, consider removing the toilet and vanity beforehand, or discuss this with us. The subfloor or walls should be clean, dry, and free of debris. Ensure access to electricity and water. Having your chosen tiles and any necessary fixtures on-site and readily accessible can also help streamline the process. We will confirm specific preparations during our pre-installation walkthrough.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear the bathroom of personal items and furniture. Ensure the area is clean, dry, and free of debris, with access to electricity and water. Have chosen tiles and fixtures ready.
